description.en: Reported revenue for the trailing twelve months ending on the report period date.
description.zh: 采用截至报告期末的最近十二个月已披露营收。

description.en: The model holds disclosed period-end common shares outstanding constant. Additional future dilution may change per-share value.
description.zh: 模型固定采用已披露的期末流通普通股数。未来进一步稀释可能改变每股价值。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: A slower device replacement cycle and regional pressure offset Services growth.
rationale.zh: 换机周期放缓与地区竞争压力抵消服务增长。

rationale.en: Normal device upgrades and recurring Services sales support cash generation.
rationale.zh: 常态化设备升级和经常性服务销售支撑现金创造。

rationale.en: A broader upgrade cycle and improving Services mix expand profitability.
rationale.zh: 更广泛的换机周期和服务组合改善推动盈利。
